audience: warehouse teams with an Extensiv API package and an External REST/Developer credential

useCases.title: Review outbound orders
useCases.text: Find a customer’s outbound orders and inspect their status, shipping details and line items.

useCases.title: Check stock by facility
useCases.text: Find an item, compare its stock totals and inspect detailed inventory by facility or lot.

useCases.title: Inspect inbound receipts
useCases.text: List inbound receivers and inspect a receipt and its item lines.

useCases.title: Submit an outbound order
useCases.text: Check for an existing order reference and look up the items and carrier services before submitting a new order for warehouse picking and shipping.
